local runtime_helpers = {
    [59] = table.pack,
    rH = function(self, dest, offset, ...)
        local values = table.pack(...)
        table.move(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, dest)
    end,
    qH = function(self, dest, offset, pack)
        for index = 1, pack.n, 1 do
            dest[offset + index] = pack[index]
        end
        dest.n = offset + pack.n
    end,
}

local module_registry = { cache = {} }

module_registry.load = function(module_name)
    if not module_registry.cache[module_name] then
        local module_cache, cache_entry = module_registry.cache, {}
        cache_entry.c, module_cache[module_name] = module_registry[module_name](), cache_entry
    end
    return module_registry.cache[module_name].c
end

module_registry.interface_root = function()
    local lifecycle, remote_library_api, interface_library =
        module_registry.load("lifecycle"),
        module_registry.load("remote_library_api"),
        module_registry.load("interface_library")
    local win = interface_library:window({
        title = "NightCC",
        script = "NightCC",
        folder = "nightcc",
        key = "Insert",
        size = { 640, 400 },
        spectators = false,
        font = "onest",
        share = { put = remote_library_api.share_put, get = remote_library_api.share_get },
    })
    remote_library_api = {
        lib = interface_library,
        win = win,
        tabs = {
            aim = win:tab({ name = "combat", icon = "crosshair" }),
            trigger = win:tab({ name = "auto", icon = "trigger" }),
            visuals = win:tab({ name = "render", icon = "eye" }),
            misc = win:tab({ name = "extras", icon = "gear" }),
            skins = (function()
                local result = win:tab({ name = "cosmetics", icon = "skins" })
                pcall(function()
                    result.nb.Visible = false
                end)
                return result
            end)(),
        },
        finish = function()
            local els = interface_library.els
            for index = 1, #els, 1 do
                els[index]:fire()
            end
            els = win:tab({ name = "config", icon = "sliders" })
            els:page("menu"):settings()
            els:page("configs"):configs()
        end,
    }
    interface_library:onunload(lifecycle.release)
    lifecycle.teardown(function()
        interface_library:unload()
    end)
    return remote_library_api
end

module_registry.collection_utilities = function()
    local table_create = table.create
    local table_clear = table.clear
    local table_move, collection_utilities_api =
        table.move, {
            trim = function(argument, argument_2)
                for index = #argument, argument_2 + 1, -1 do
                    argument[index] = nil
                end
                return argument
            end,
            drop = function(argument_3, argument_4)
                local computed_value = #argument_3
                argument_3[argument_4] = argument_3[computed_value]
                argument_3[computed_value] = nil
            end,
        }
    collection_utilities_api.copy_with = function(argument_5, argument_6, argument_7)
        local computed_value_2 = #argument_6
        table_move(argument_6, 1, computed_value_2, 1, argument_5)
        if argument_7 ~= nil then
            computed_value_2 += 1
            argument_5[computed_value_2] = argument_7
        end
        return collection_utilities_api.trim(argument_5, computed_value_2)
    end
    local state_2 = {}
    state_2.__index = state_2
    state_2.new = function(argument_8)
        return setmetatable({ items = table_create(argument_8 or 8), head = 1, tail = 0 }, state_2)
    end
    state_2.count = function(argument_9)
        return argument_9.tail - argument_9.head + 1
    end
    state_2.push = function(argument_10, argument_11)
        local computed_value_3 = argument_10.tail + 1
        argument_10.tail = computed_value_3
        argument_10.items[computed_value_3] = argument_11
        return argument_11
    end
    state_2.peek = function(argument_12)
        if argument_12.head > argument_12.tail then
            return nil
        end
        return argument_12.items[argument_12.head]
    end
    state_2.shift = function(argument_13)
        local head_2 = argument_13.head
        if head_2 > argument_13.tail then
            return nil
        end
        local items = argument_13.items
        local entry = items[head_2]
        items[head_2] = nil
        argument_13.head = head_2 + 1
        if argument_13.head > argument_13.tail then
            argument_13.head = 1
            argument_13.tail = 0
        elseif head_2 > 64 then
            local computed_value_4 = argument_13.tail - head_2
            table_move(items, head_2 + 1, argument_13.tail, 1)
            collection_utilities_api.trim(items, computed_value_4)
            argument_13.head = 1
            argument_13.tail = computed_value_4
        end
        return entry
    end
    state_2.remove = function(argument_14, argument_15)
        local items_2 = argument_14.items
        table_move(items_2, argument_15 + 1, argument_14.tail, argument_15)
        items_2[argument_14.tail] = nil
        argument_14.tail = argument_14.tail - 1
        if argument_14.head > argument_14.tail then
            argument_14.head = 1
            argument_14.tail = 0
        end
    end
    state_2.reset = function(argument_16)
        table_clear(argument_16.items)
        argument_16.head = 1
        argument_16.tail = 0
    end
    collection_utilities_api.queue = state_2
    local state_3 = {}
    state_3.__index = state_3
    state_3.new = function(create, hide)
        return setmetatable({ items = {}, create = create, hide = hide, count = 0, used = 0 }, state_3)
    end
    state_3.open = function(argument_17)
        argument_17.used = 0
    end
    state_3.next = function(argument_18)
        local computed_value_5 = argument_18.used + 1
        argument_18.used = computed_value_5
        local entry_2 = argument_18.items[computed_value_5]
        if entry_2 == nil then
            entry_2 = argument_18.create()
            if entry_2 == nil then
                argument_18.used = computed_value_5 - 1
                return nil
            end
            argument_18.items[computed_value_5] = entry_2
            if computed_value_5 > argument_18.count then
                argument_18.count = computed_value_5
            end
        end
        return entry_2
    end
    state_3.close = function(argument_19)
        local hide_2 = argument_19.hide
        if not hide_2 then
            return
        end
        local items_3 = argument_19.items
        for index_2 = argument_19.used + 1, argument_19.count, 1 do
            local entry_3 = items_3[index_2]
            if entry_3 ~= nil then
                hide_2(entry_3)
            end
        end
    end
    state_3.purge = function(argument_20, argument_21)
        local items_4 = argument_20.items
        for index_3 = argument_20.count, 1, -1 do
            local entry_4 = items_4[index_3]
            items_4[index_3] = nil
            if entry_4 ~= nil then
                if argument_21 then
                    argument_21(entry_4)
                end
            end
        end
        argument_20.count = 0
        argument_20.used = 0
    end
    collection_utilities_api.pool = state_3
    return collection_utilities_api
end

    local function helper_3(argument_9)

module_registry.character_proxies = function()

    local new = Vector3.new

        Vector3.one, {
            "Head",

            "LeftLowerArm",

            "RightUpperArm",
            "RightLowerArm",

            return nil
        end
        local result, off_2, size_2, number_value = humanoid_root_part.CFrame:Inverse(), {}, {}, 0
        for instance_2 = 1, #names, 1 do

            return nil
        end

    end
    character_proxies_api.grab = helper
    local function helper_2(argument)

            argument = viewport.AbsoluteSize

                return Vector2.zero, false, 0

                return Vector2.zero, false, 0

                result.X / (computed_value * result_2 * (argument.X / argument.Y)),

                computed_value_4.Y + argument.Y * (0.5 - computed_value_3 * 0.5)

            links.removed = nil
        end

module_registry.body_adornments = function()
    local roblox_services = module_registry.load("roblox_services")
    local lifecycle = module_registry.load("lifecycle")
    local visual_utilities = module_registry.load("visual_utilities")
    local visual_frame_cache = module_registry.load("visual_frame_cache")
    local character_tracking = module_registry.load("character_tracking")
    local workspace_2 = roblox_services.workspace
    local local_player = roblox_services.lp
    local white = visual_utilities.white
    local math_min = math.min
    local math_max = math.max
    local new, state_2, state_3 = Vector3.new, { ["Counter-Terrorists"] = true, CT = true }, {}
    state_3.UpperTorso = new(1, 1.04, 1)
    state_3.LowerTorso = new(0.95, 1.5, 1)
    state_3.Torso = new(1, 1, 1)
    local computed_value = Enum.AdornShading and Enum.AdornShading.XRay or nil
    local computed_value_2 = Enum.AdornCullingMode and Enum.AdornCullingMode.Never or nil
    if type(setfflag) == "function" then
        pcall(setfflag, "AdornShadingAPI", "True")
    end
    local instance, instance_2
    local function helper()
        local current_camera = workspace_2.CurrentCamera
        if not current_camera then
            return nil
        end
        if if instance then not instance.Parent else not instance then
            instance = Instance.new("Folder")
            instance.Parent = current_camera
            lifecycle.own(instance)
            instance_2 = Instance.new("Part")
            local value_2 = instance_2
            value_2.Size = Vector3.one
            instance_2.Anchored = true
            instance_2.CanCollide = false
            instance_2.CanQuery = false
            instance_2.CanTouch = false
            instance_2.CastShadow = false
            instance_2.Massless = true
            instance_2.Locked = true
            instance_2.Transparency = 1
            instance_2.Parent = instance
        elseif instance.Parent ~= current_camera then
            instance.Parent = current_camera
        end
        current_camera = instance
        return current_camera
    end
    local computed_value_3 = Vector3.one * 0.004
    local transform = CFrame.new()
    local zero, enabled, number_value, body_adornments_api = Vector3.zero, false, 0, {}
    body_adornments_api.__index = body_adornments_api
    body_adornments_api.begin_frame = function(argument)
        local current_camera_2 = workspace_2.CurrentCamera
        if not current_camera_2 then
            return false
        end
        if not (helper()) then
            return false
        end
        local cframe = current_camera_2.CFrame
        instance_2.CFrame = cframe
        transform = cframe:Inverse()
        zero = cframe.Position
        number_value += argument or 0
        enabled = number_value >= 0.6
        if enabled then
            number_value = 0
        end
        return true
    end
    local function helper_2(argument_2)
        local number_value_2 = tonumber(argument_2.chamsGlow) or 4

module_registry.player_highlights = function()
    local roblox_services, visual_utilities =
        module_registry.load("roblox_services"), module_registry.load("visual_utilities")
    local visual_frame_cache = module_registry.load("visual_frame_cache")
    local local_player = roblox_services.lp
    local white = visual_utilities.white
    local always_on_top, player_highlights_api = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop, {}
    player_highlights_api.__index = player_highlights_api
    player_highlights_api.new = function(plr, itf)
        return setmetatable({
            plr = plr,
            itf = itf,
            inst = nil,
            char = nil,
            root = nil,
            links = {},
            dirty = false,
            on = false,
            fc = nil,
            oc = nil,
            ft = nil,
            ot = nil,
        }, player_highlights_api)
    end
    player_highlights_api.drop_links = function(connection)
        local links = connection.links
        for index = #links, 1, -1 do
            connection = links[index]
            links[index] = nil
            pcall(connection.Disconnect, connection)
        end
    end
    player_highlights_api.watch = function(argument, argument_2)
        argument:drop_links()
        if not argument_2 then
            return
        end
        local links_2 = argument.links
        local function helper()
            argument.dirty = true
        end
        links_2[1] = argument_2.ChildAdded:Connect(helper)
        links_2[2] = argument_2.ChildRemoved:Connect(helper)
    end
    player_highlights_api.hide = function(argument_3)
        local inst_2 = argument_3.inst
        if argument_3.on then
            argument_3.on = false
            if inst_2 then
                inst_2.Enabled = false
            end
        elseif inst_2 then
            if inst_2.Enabled then
                argument_3.on = false
                if inst_2 then
                    inst_2.Enabled = false
                end
            end
        end
    end
    player_highlights_api.unbind = function(argument_4)
        argument_4:hide()
        argument_4:drop_links()
        argument_4.char = nil
        argument_4.root = nil
        argument_4.dirty = false
        local inst_3 = argument_4.inst
        if inst_3 then
            inst_3.Adornee = nil
        end
    end
    player_highlights_api.ensure = function(argument_5)
        local inst_4, holder = argument_5.inst, visual_utilities.holder
        if inst_4 then
            if inst_4.Parent == holder then
                return inst_4
            end
        end
        if inst_4 then
            pcall(inst_4.Destroy, inst_4)
        end
        inst_4 = Instance.new("Highlight")
        inst_4.Enabled = false
        inst_4.DepthMode = always_on_top
        inst_4.Parent = holder
        argument_5.inst = inst_4
        argument_5.char = nil
        argument_5.on = false
        argument_5.fc = nil
        argument_5.oc = nil
        argument_5.ft = nil
        argument_5.ot = nil
        return inst_4
    end
    player_highlights_api.update = function(argument_6)
        local itf_2 = argument_6.itf
        local instance = visual_frame_cache.shared_for(itf_2, argument_6.plr)
        local opt, char_2, value_2 = instance.opt, instance.char, instance.en
        if
            (if value_2 then not opt else not value_2)
            or not opt.hlt
            or not char_2
            or not char_2.Parent
            or argument_6.plr == local_player
        then
            if argument_6.char then
                argument_6:unbind()
            end
            return
        end
        value_2, instance = argument_6:ensure(), argument_6.root
        if argument_6.char ~= char_2 then
            argument_6.char = char_2
            instance = char_2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char_2:FindFirstChild("Head")
            argument_6.root = instance
            argument_6.dirty = false
            argument_6:watch(char_2)
            value_2.Adornee = char_2
        else
            if if instance then instance.Parent ~= char_2 else not instance then
                instance = char_2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char_2:FindFirstChild("Head")
                argument_6.root = instance
                argument_6.dirty = instance ~= nil
            end
            if argument_6.dirty or value_2.Adornee ~= char_2 then
                argument_6.dirty = false
                value_2.Adornee = nil
                value_2.Adornee = char_2
                argument_6.on = false
            end
        end
        if not instance then
            argument_6:hide()
            return
        end
        char_2 = itf_2.shSet
        if char_2.limDis then
            itf_2 = tonumber(char_2.maxDis)
            if itf_2 then
                if (visual_utilities.view_frame().Position - instance.Position).Magnitude > itf_2 then
                    argument_6:hide()
                    return
                end
            end
        end
        instance, itf_2 = opt.hltFCol, opt.hltOCol
        local white_2, white_3, computed_value, computed_value_2 =
            visual_utilities.parse_col(argument_6, instance[1]) or white,
            visual_utilities.parse_col(argument_6, itf_2[1]) or white,
            1 - (tonumber(instance[2]) or 0.5),
            1 - (tonumber(itf_2[2]) or 1)

            argument_6.fc = white_2
            value_2.FillColor = white_2
        end
        if argument_6.oc ~= white_3 then
            argument_6.oc = white_3
            value_2.OutlineColor = white_3
        end
        if argument_6.ft ~= computed_value then
            argument_6.ft = computed_value
            value_2.FillTransparency = computed_value
        end
        if argument_6.ot ~= computed_value_2 then
            argument_6.ot = computed_value_2

        end
        if argument_6.on then

module_registry.instance_labels = function()
    local visual_utilities = module_registry.load("visual_utilities")
    local drawing_renderer = module_registry.load("drawing_renderer")
    local esp_primitives = module_registry.load("esp_primitives")
    local white = visual_utilities.white
    local color_2 = Color3.new()
    local math_round, instance_labels_api = math.round, {}
    instance_labels_api.__index = instance_labels_api
    instance_labels_api.new = function(argument, opt)
        opt = assert(opt, "No options")
        opt.en = opt.en == nil and true or opt.en
        opt.txt = opt.txt or "{name}"
        opt.txtCol = opt.txtCol or { K, 1 }
        opt.txtOut = opt.txtOut == nil and true or opt.txtOut
        opt.txtOCol = opt.txtOCol or color_2
        opt.txtSz = opt.txtSz or 13
        opt.txtFnt = opt.txtFnt or 3
        opt.limDis = opt.limDis or false
        opt.maxDis = opt.maxDis or 150
        opt.txtGrd = opt.txtGrd or false
        opt.txtGrdCol = opt.txtGrdCol or { K, Color3.new(1, 0, 0) }
        return setmetatable(
            { inst = assert(argument, "No instance"), opt = opt, ph = math.random(), dead = false },
            instance_labels_api
        )
    end
    instance_labels_api.update = function(argument_2) end
    instance_labels_api.draw = function(argument_3)
        if argument_3.dead then
            return
        end
        local inst_2 = argument_3.inst
        if inst_2 then
            if not inst_2.Parent then
                argument_3.dead = true
                return
            end
        else
            argument_3.dead = true
            return
        end
        local opt_2 = argument_3.opt
        if not opt_2.en then
            return
        end
        local ok_2, part_2 = pcall(inst_2.GetPivot, inst_2)
        if not ok_2 then
            return
        end
        ok_2 = part_2.Position
        local result, value_2, value_3 = visual_utilities.to_screen(ok_2)
        if result then
            if not value_2 then
                return
            end
        else
            return
        end
        if opt_2.limDis then
            if value_3 > opt_2.maxDis then
                return
            end
        end
        local result_2, txt_sz, computed_value =
            opt_2.txt
                :gsub("{name}", inst_2.Name)
                :gsub("{distance}", math_round(value_3))
                :gsub("{position}", tostring(ok_2)),
            opt_2.txtSz,
            opt_2.txtOut and opt_2.txtOCol or nil
        if opt_2.txtGrd then
            esp_primitives.grad_text(
                result_2,
                result.X,
                result.Y,
                txt_sz,
                computed_value,
                opt_2.txtCol[2],
                opt_2.txtGrdCol[1],
                opt_2.txtGrdCol[2],
                argument_3.ph
            )
        elseif computed_value then
            drawing_renderer.outlined_text(
                result,
                txt_sz,
                opt_2.txtCol[1],
                opt_2.txtCol[2],
                computed_value,
                opt_2.txtCol[2],
                result_2,
                true
            )
        else
            drawing_renderer.text(result, txt_sz, opt_2.txtCol[1], opt_2.txtCol[2], result_2, true)
        end
    end
    instance_labels_api.destroy = function(argument_4)
        argument_4.dead = true
        argument_4.inst = nil
    end
    return instance_labels_api
end

    end
    esp_manager_api.Unload = function()

        end

        for index_9 = #state_3, 1, -1 do

        local function getFolder()

            if not cam then
                return nil
            end

                return folder
            end

                pcall(function()
                    folder:Destroy()

        local function updateWings(torso, argument_35)
            if not state_5.wings then
                if #state_6.parts > 0 then
                    clearWings()

            if state_6.key ~= state_5.wingStyle or #state_6.parts == 0 then
                buildWings()

            local scale = state_5.wingSize
            if state_6.size ~= scale then
                for key_6, rec in ipairs(state_6.parts) do
                    local value_4 = rec.r
                    local value_5, value_6, value_7

                end
                state_6.c1, state_6.c2 = state_5.wingC1, state_5.wingC2
            end
            local flap = math.rad(8) + math.rad(state_5.wingAmp) * math.sin(argument_35 * state_5.wingSpeed)
            local sweep = math.rad(22)
            local base = torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.35, 0.62)
            local hinge = {}
            for key_9, side in ipairs({ 1, -1 }) do
                hinge[side] = base
                    * CFrame.new(side * 0.3, 0, 0)
                    * CFrame.Angles(0, -side * sweep, 0)
                    * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, side * flap)
            end
            for key_10, rec in ipairs(state_6.parts) do
                local value_8, side = rec.r, rec.side
                local computed_value_9 = (value_8.row or 0) * 0.04 * scale

                    rec.part.CFrame = hinge[side]
                        * CFrame.new(side * value_8.cx * scale, value_8.cy * scale, computed_value_9)
                        * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, side * value_8.tilt)

                    local computed_value_10, result_8 = side * math.cos(value_8.a), math.sin(value_8.a)

                        * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.atan2(-computed_value_10, result_8))
                end
            end
        end

        local function placeRing(list, center, radius, spin, argument_37, argument_38, argument_39)
            local computed_value_11 = #list
            for key_11, part_4 in ipairs(list) do
                local computed_value_12 = spin + (key_11 - 1) * (2 * math.pi / computed_value_11)
                local pos = center
                    + Vector3.new(
                        math.cos(computed_value_12) * radius,
                        0,
                        math.sin(computed_value_12) * radius
                    )
                local tangent = Vector3.new(-math.sin(computed_value_12), 0, math.cos(computed_value_12))
                part_4.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + tangent)
                part_4.Color =
                    argument_37:Lerp(argument_38, 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(computed_value_12 - argument_39))
            end
        end

        local function jointsWorld(model)
            local function part(name_4)
                return model:FindFirstChild(name_4)
            end
            local function top(part_6)
                return part_6.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, part_6.Size.Y / 2, 0))
            end
            local function bottom(part_7)
                return part_7.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, -part_7.Size.Y / 2, 0))
            end
            local head, result_12, part_8 = part("Head"), part("UpperTorso"), part("LowerTorso")
            if head and result_12 and part_8 then
                local lua, part_9, rua, part_10 =
                    part("LeftUpperArm"), part("LeftHand"), part("RightUpperArm"), part("RightHand")
                local lul, part_11, rul, part_12 =
                    part("LeftUpperLeg"), part("LeftFoot"), part("RightUpperLeg"), part("RightFoot")
                if lua and part_9 and rua and part_10 and lul and part_11 and rul and part_12 then
                    return {
                        head = head.Position,
                        neck = top(result_12),
                        pelvis = part_8.Position,
                        ls = top(lua),
                        rs = top(rua),
                        lh = part_9.Position,
                        rh = part_10.Position,
                        lhip = top(lul),
                        rhip = top(rul),
                        lf = part_11.Position,
                        rf = part_12.Position,
                    }
                end
            end
            local torso, result_13, result_14, result_15, result_16 =
                part("Torso"), part("Left Arm"), part("Right Arm"), part("Left Leg"), part("Right Leg")
            if head and torso and result_13 and result_14 and result_15 and result_16 then
                return {
                    head = head.Position,
                    neck = top(torso),
                    pelvis = bottom(torso),
                    ls = top(result_13),
                    rs = top(result_14),
                    lh = bottom(result_13),
                    rh = bottom(result_14),
                    lhip = top(result_15),
                    rhip = top(result_16),
                    lf = bottom(result_15),
                    rf = bottom(result_16),
                }
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function rollArc(argument_44)
            local dir = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * 1.2, math.random() - 0.5)
            if dir.Magnitude < 0.05 then
                dir = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
            end
            dir = dir.Unit
            local computed_value_15 = dir * 1.0
            local computed_value_16 = dir * (2.6 + math.random() * 1.2)
            local pts = { s0 }
            local computed_value_17 = #argument_44.parts
            for index_7 = 1, computed_value_17 - 1 do
                local computed_value_18 = index_7 / computed_value_17
                local jitter = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5)
                    * 1.1
                pts[#pts + 1] = computed_value_15
                    + (computed_value_16 - computed_value_15) * computed_value_18
                    + jitter
            end
            pts[#pts + 1] = computed_value_16
            argument_44.pts = pts
        end

        local function ensureGrad(inst)
            local uigradient = inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
            if not uigradient then

        end
        local function dropGrad(inst)
            local uigradient_2 = inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")

                uigradient_2:Destroy()
            end
        end

        local MODEL = {

        local function disposeModel()
            if MODEL.clone then
                pcall(function()
                    MODEL.clone:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            MODEL.clone, MODEL.base, MODEL.stash, MODEL.active, MODEL.chamsOn = nil, nil, nil, false, false

        local function buildModel()
            disposeModel()
            MODEL.dirty = false
            if state_19.modelMode ~= "My character" or not MODEL.vp then
                return
            end
            local char = LP_.Character
            MODEL.srcChar = char
            if not (char and char.Parent and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) then
                return
            end
            local clone
            local was = char.Archivable
            pcall(function()
                char.Archivable = true
                clone = char:Clone()
            end)
            pcall(function()
                char.Archivable = was
            end)
            if not clone then
                return
            end
            for key_25, instance_3 in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
                if
                    instance_3:IsA("BaseScript")
                    or instance_3:IsA("Sound")
                    or instance_3:IsA("ForceField")
                    or instance_3:IsA("Highlight")
                    or instance_3:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
                    or instance_3:IsA("Trail")
                    or instance_3:IsA("Beam")
                    or instance_3:IsA("Fire")
                    or instance_3:IsA("Smoke")
                    or instance_3:IsA("Sparkles")
                    or instance_3:IsA("PointLight")
                    or instance_3:IsA("BillboardGui")
                then
                    pcall(function()
                        instance_3:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
            end
            local visible = 0
            local stash = {}
            for key_26, inst_2 in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
                if inst_2:IsA("BasePart") then
                    pcall(function()
                        inst_2.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                    end)
                    local state_21 = {
                        inst = inst_2,
                        Color = inst_2.Color,
                        Material = inst_2.Material,
                        Transparency = inst_2.Transparency,
                    }
                    if inst_2:IsA("MeshPart") then
                        state_21.TextureID = inst_2.TextureID
                    end
                    stash[#stash + 1] = state_21
                    if inst_2.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and inst_2.Transparency < 0.9 then
                        visible = visible + 1
                    end
                elseif inst_2:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                    stash[#stash + 1] = { inst = inst_2, TextureId = inst_2.TextureId }
                elseif inst_2:IsA("Decal") or inst_2:IsA("Texture") then
                    stash[#stash + 1] = { inst = inst_2, Transparency = inst_2.Transparency }
                end
            end
            if visible < 3 then
                pcall(function()
                    clone:Destroy()
                end)
                return
            end
            clone.Parent = MODEL.vp
            local root = clone:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local pivot = clone:GetPivot()
            clone:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0) * root.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(pivot))
            local bbCF, bbSize = clone:GetBoundingBox()
            if bbSize.Y < 1 then
                pcall(function()
                    clone:Destroy()
                end)
                return
            end
            MODEL.center = bbCF.Position
            MODEL.base = clone:GetPivot()
            MODEL.clone, MODEL.stash, MODEL.active = clone, stash, true
            local cam = MODEL.cam
            cam.FieldOfView = 30
            local spp = bbSize.Y / number_value_5
            local dist = (STAGE_H * spp / 2) / math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView) / 2)
            local camY = MODEL.center.Y - (STAGE_H / 2 - (number_value_4 + number_value_5 / 2)) * spp
            cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(MODEL.center.X, camY, MODEL.center.Z + dist)
        end
        local function projectToStage(argument_64)
            local cam = MODEL.cam
            local result_32 = cam.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(argument_64)
            local depth = -result_32.Z
            if depth < 0.1 then
                return nil
            end
            local result_33 = math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView) / 2)
            local computed_value_24 = (result_32.X / (depth * result_33 * (number_value / STAGE_H))) * 0.5
                + 0.5
            local computed_value_25 = 0.5 - (result_32.Y / (depth * result_33)) * 0.5
            return { computed_value_24 * number_value, computed_value_25 * STAGE_H }
        end
        local function setChams(argument_65, color, transparency)
            if not MODEL.stash then
                return
            end
            if argument_65 then
                for key_27, item_13 in ipairs(MODEL.stash) do
                    local inst_3 = item_13.inst
                    pcall(function()
                        if inst_3:IsA("BasePart") then
                            if item_13.Transparency < 0.9 then
                                inst_3.Color, inst_3.Material, inst_3.Transparency =
                                    color, Enum.Material.Neon, transparency
                            end
                            if item_13.TextureID ~= nil then
                                inst_3.TextureID = ""
                            end
                        elseif inst_3:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                            inst_3.TextureId = ""
                        else
                            inst_3.Transparency = 1
                        end
                    end)
                end
                MODEL.chamsOn = true
            elseif MODEL.chamsOn then
                for key_28, item_14 in ipairs(MODEL.stash) do
                    for key_29, item_15 in pairs(item_14) do
                        if key_29 ~= "inst" then
                            pcall(function()
                                item_14.inst[key_29] = item_15
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end
                MODEL.chamsOn = false
            end
        end
        local function modelStep(argument_66, chams, argument_67, argument_68)
            if MODEL.srcChar ~= LP_.Character then
                MODEL.dirty = true
            end
            if MODEL.dirty then
                buildModel()
            end
            if MODEL.vp then
                MODEL.vp.Visible = MODEL.active
            end
            if not (MODEL.active and MODEL.clone) then
                return nil
            end
            local yaw = math.sin(argument_66 * 0.7) * 0.35
            local vector = Vector3.new(MODEL.center.X, 0, MODEL.center.Z)
            MODEL.clone:PivotTo(
                CFrame.new(vector) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.new(-vector) * MODEL.base
            )
            if chams then
                setChams(true, argument_67, math.clamp(argument_68, 0, 0.9))
            else
                setChams(false)
            end
            local result_34 = jointsWorld(MODEL.clone)
            if not result_34 then
                return nil
            end
            local out = {}
            for key_30, item_16 in pairs(result_34) do
                local result_35 = projectToStage(item_16)
                if not result_35 then
                    return nil
                end
                out[key_30] = result_35
            end
            return out
        end

        local function previewColor()
            local state_23 = state_19.state
            if state_23 == "Teammate" then
                return aC.espTeamColor
            end
            if state_23 == "Visible" and aC.espVisCheck then
                return aC.espVisColor
            end
            if state_23 == "Dormant" and aC.espDormant then
                return Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 160)
            end
            if aC.espColorMode == "Team Side" then
                if state_23 == "T side" then
                    return aC.espTColor
                end
                if state_23 == "CT side" then
                    return aC.espCTColor
                end
            end
            return aC.espEnemyColor
        end

            local function ensureDrops(argument_81, count)

            local function spawnRing(
                argument_85,

                argument_87,

                end
                value_10.active, value_10.t0, value_10.life, value_10.maxD, value_10.x, value_10.y, value_10.z =
                    true, argument_89, life, maxD, argument_86, argument_87, argument_88
                value_10.part.Color = state_25.rainColor:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.5)
            end
            local function updateRings(argument_90)
                for key_46, item_30 in ipairs(rings) do
                    if item_30.active then
                        local computed_value_33 = (argument_90 - item_30.t0) / item_30.life
                        if computed_value_33 >= 1 then
                            item_30.active = false
                            item_30.part.Transparency = 1
                        else
                            local computed_value_34 = 0.3 + item_30.maxD * computed_value_33
                            item_30.part.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, computed_value_34, computed_value_34)
                            item_30.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(item_30.x, item_30.y, item_30.z)
                                * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)
                            item_30.part.Transparency = 0.35 + 0.65 * computed_value_33
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local function updatePrints(argument_91, root, argument_92)

            local function boltPath(argument_93, argument_94, argument_95, jitter)
                local pts = { a }
                for index_16 = 1, argument_95 - 1 do
                    local computed_value_36 = index_16 / argument_95
                    local computed_value_37 = jitter * (1 - computed_value_36 * 0.6)
                    pts[#pts + 1] = argument_93:Lerp(argument_94, computed_value_36)
                        + Vector3.new(
                            rng:NextNumber(-computed_value_37, computed_value_37),
                            0,
                            rng:NextNumber(-computed_value_37, computed_value_37)
                        )
                end
                pts[#pts + 1] = argument_94
                return pts
            end
            local function playThunder(dist)
                local result_54 = tostring(state_25.thunderId or ""):gsub("%D", "")
                if result_54 == "" then
                    return
                end
                task.delay(0.25 + dist * 0.012, function()
                    if not state_25.on then
                        return
                    end
                    local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
                    sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. result_54
                    sound.Volume = state_25.thunderVol
                    sound.PlaybackSpeed = rng:NextNumber(0.85, 1.05)
                    sound.Parent = SoundService_
                    sound:Play()
                    task.delay(15, function()
                        if sound.Parent then
                            sound:Destroy()
                        end
                    end)
                end)
            end
            local function strike(argument_96, root, argument_97)
                local ang = rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2)
                local dist = rng:NextNumber(35, 110)
                local vector_2 = Vector3.new(
                    root.Position.X + math.cos(ang) * dist,
                    groundY,
                    root.Position.Z + math.sin(ang) * dist
                )
                local top = vector_2 + Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-18, 18), 130, rng:NextNumber(-18, 18))
                local parts = {}
                local function addPath(pts, argument_98)
                    for index_17 = 1, #pts - 1 do
                        local entry_8, entry_9 = pts[index_17], pts[index_17 + 1]
                        local len = (entry_9 - entry_8).Magnitude
                        if len > 0.05 then
                            local y_axis = math.abs((entry_9 - entry_8).Unit.Y) > 0.999 and Vector3.zAxis
                                or Vector3.yAxis
                            local part_26 = mkPart(
                                argument_96,
                                Vector3.new(argument_98, argument_98, len),
                                Color3.fromRGB(215, 230, 255),
                                0
                            )
                            part_26.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(entry_8, entry_9, y_axis)
                                * CFrame.new(0, 0, -len / 2)
                            parts[#parts + 1] = part_26
                        end
                    end
                end
                local main = boltPath(top, vector_2, 16, 9)
                addPath(main, 0.55)
                for index_18 = 1, rng:NextInteger(1, 2) do
                    local entry_10 = main[rng:NextInteger(5, 11)]
                    local computed_value_38 = entry_10
                        + Vector3.new(
                            rng:NextNumber(-30, 30),
                            -rng:NextNumber(25, 50),
                            rng:NextNumber(-30, 30)
                        )
                    addPath(boltPath(entry_10, computed_value_38, 6, 4), 0.28)
                end
                bolts[#bolts + 1] = { parts = parts, t0 = argument_97 }
                flashT0 = argument_97
                playThunder(dist)
            end
            local function updateBolts(argument_99)
                for index_19 = #bolts, 1, -1 do
                    local entry_11 = bolts[index_19]
                    local age = argument_99 - entry_11.t0
                    if age > 0.5 then
                        for key_49, instance_8 in ipairs(entry_11.parts) do
                            pcall(function()
                                instance_8:Destroy()
                            end)
                        end
                        table.remove(bolts, index_19)
                    else
                        local flick = (age < 0.12 or (age > 0.18 and age < 0.3)) and 0 or 0.7
                        local result_55 = math.clamp(flick + (age / 0.5) * 0.3, 0, 1)
                        for key_50, item_33 in ipairs(entry_11.parts) do
                            item_33.Transparency = result_55
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local function updateScreen(argument_100)
                if not (state_25.flash or state_25.gloom) then
                    if instance_4 then
                        instance_4.Enabled = false
                    end
                    return
                end
                if not instance_4 or not instance_4.Parent then
                    instance_4 = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
                    instance_4.Name = "NightCCStormCC"
                    instance_4.Parent = Lighting_
                end
                instance_4.Enabled = true
                local age = argument_100 - flashT0
                local pulse = 0
                if age >= 0 and age < 0.9 then
                    pulse = math.exp(-age * 9)
                    if age > 0.14 then
                        pulse = math.max(pulse, 0.7 * math.exp(-(age - 0.14) * 7))
                    end
                end
                instance_4.Brightness = (state_25.gloom and -0.06 or 0)
                    + (state_25.flash and pulse * state_25.flashPower or 0)
                instance_4.Saturation = state_25.gloom and -0.25 or 0
                instance_4.Contrast = state_25.gloom and 0.06 or 0
                instance_4.TintColor = state_25.gloom and Color3.fromRGB(205, 218, 240) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            end
            local function updateMist(argument_101, root, argument_102)
                if argument_102 then
                    if not mist or not mist.Parent then
                        local result_56 = mkPart(
                            argument_101,
                            Vector3.new(16, 0.5, 16),
                            Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
                            1,
                            Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                        )
                        local particle_emitter_3 = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                        particle_emitter_3.Texture = MIST_TEXTURE
                        particle_emitter_3.Rate = 7
                        particle_emitter_3.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(3, 5)
                        particle_emitter_3.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.4, 1)
                        particle_emitter_3.Size = NumberSequence.new({
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 6),
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 13),
                        })
                        particle_emitter_3.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, 0.86),
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
                        })
                        particle_emitter_3.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(200, 210, 225))
                        particle_emitter_3.LightInfluence = 0.6
                        particle_emitter_3.Parent = result_56
                        mist = result_56
                    end
                    mist.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position.X, groundY + 0.8, root.Position.Z)
                elseif mist then
                    pcall(function()
                        mist:Destroy()
                    end)
                    mist = nil
                end
            end
            avRuntime.connect(RunService_.RenderStepped, function(argument_103)
                if not state_25.on then
                    if active then
                        clearStorm()
                        active = false
                    end
                    return
                end
                local char, root = bodyParts()
                if not char or char:GetAttribute("Dead") == true then
                    if active then
                        clearStorm()
                        active = false
                    end
                    return
                end
                local result_57 = folderGet()
                if not result_57 then
                    return
                end
                active = true
                local result_58 = os.clock()
                local position_5 = root.Position
                rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, f }
                local hit = workspace:Raycast(position_5, Vector3.new(0, -14, 0), rayParams)
                if hit then
                    groundY, groundOk = hit.Position.Y, true
                else
                    groundOk = false
                end
                sheltered = workspace:Raycast(position_5, Vector3.new(0, 60, 0), rayParams) ~= nil
                if state_25.rain then
                    ensureDrops(result_57, math.floor(state_25.amount))
                    if sheltered ~= lastSheltered then
                        lastSheltered = sheltered
                        for key_51, item_34 in ipairs(drops) do
                            item_34.part.Transparency = sheltered and 1 or 0.55
                        end
                    end
                    local prs, cfs = {}, {}
                    for key_52, item_35 in ipairs(drops) do
                        if item_35.fresh then
                            item_35.fresh = false
                            respawnDrop(item_35, position_5.X, position_5.Z, groundY + rng:NextNumber(0, 26))
                        end
                        item_35.y = item_35.y - item_35.v * argument_103
                        local computed_value_39, computed_value_40 =
                            item_35.x - position_5.X, item_35.z - position_5.Z
                        if
                            item_35.y < groundY
                            or computed_value_39 * computed_value_39
                                    + computed_value_40 * computed_value_40
                                > RADIUS * RADIUS * 1.2
                        then
                            respawnDrop(
                                item_35,
                                position_5.X,
                                position_5.Z,
                                groundY + 24 + rng:NextNumber(0, 6)
                            )
                        end
                        prs[key_52] = item_35.part
                        cfs[key_52] = CFrame.new(item_35.x, item_35.y, item_35.z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0.1)
                    end
                    pcall(workspace.BulkMoveTo, workspace, prs, cfs, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
                elseif #drops > 0 then
                    ensureDrops(result_57, 0)
                end
                if state_25.puddle then
                    ensurePuddle(result_57)
                end
                updatePuddle(root, result_58, state_25.puddle)
                if
                    state_25.puddle
                    and state_25.rain
                    and groundOk
                    and not sheltered
                    and result_58 >= nextRing
                then
                    nextRing = result_58 + 1 / math.max(state_25.amount * 0.35, 4)
                    local result_59 = rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2)
                    local computed_value_41 = math.sqrt(rng:NextNumber()) * state_25.puddleSize * 0.5
                    spawnRing(
                        result_57,
                        position_5.X + math.cos(result_59) * computed_value_41,
                        groundY + 0.07,
                        position_5.Z + math.sin(result_59) * computed_value_41,
                        0.55,
                        1.6,
                        result_58
                    )
                end
                updateRings(result_58)
                updatePrints(result_57, root, result_58)
                if state_25.shine then
                    if result_58 >= wetAt then
                        wetAt = result_58 + 1
                        wetBody(char, true)
                    end
                elseif next(wet) ~= nil then
                    wetBody(nil, false)
                end
                if state_25.lightning and result_58 >= nextBolt then
                    if nextBolt ~= 0 and groundOk then
                        strike(result_57, root, result_58)
                    end
                    nextBolt = result_58 + state_25.every * rng:NextNumber(0.5, 1.5)
                end
                updateBolts(result_58)
                updateScreen(result_58)
                updateMist(result_57, root, state_25.mist and groundOk)
            end)
            avRuntime.teardown(function()
                state_25.on = false
                pcall(clearStorm)
            end)
            avTab:Section({ Title = "storm and wet floor" })
            avTab:Toggle({

            local Lighting_ = game:GetService("Lighting")

                lightRange = 18,

                bloom = false,
                bloomInt = 0.4,
                rays = false,
                raysInt = 0.1,
                grade = "Off",
                gradeInt = 0.6,
                rainbow = false,
                bright = 0.6,
            }
            local rng = Random.new()
            local instance_9
            local pools = { orbs = {}, circle = {}, amb = {}, ghosts = {}, waves = {} }
            local orbsStyle, ambStyle
            local active = false
            local holoOrig = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
            local holoAt, lastGhost, lastFloor, lastVy = 0, 0, true, 0
            local state_27 = {}
            local function mkPart(parent, size, color, transp)
                local part_27 = Instance.new("Part")
                part_27.Anchored, part_27.CanCollide, part_27.CanQuery, part_27.CanTouch, part_27.CastShadow =
                    true, false, false, false, false
                part_27.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                part_27.Color = color
                part_27.Transparency = transp
                part_27.Size =
                    Vector3.new(math.max(size.X, 0.05), math.max(size.Y, 0.05), math.max(size.Z, 0.05))
                part_27.Parent = parent
                return part_27
            end
            local function col(base, argument_170, argument_171)
                local base_2 = base
                if state_26.rainbow then
                    base_2 = Color3.fromHSV((argument_170 * 0.15 + (argument_171 or 0) * 0.08) % 1, 0.75, 1)
                end
                local computed_value_42 = 0.35 + 0.65 * state_26.bright
                return Color3.new(
                    base_2.R * computed_value_42,
                    base_2.G * computed_value_42,
                    base_2.B * computed_value_42
                )
            end
            local function helper_9(argument_172)
                return 1 - (1 - argument_172) * state_26.bright
            end
            local function bulk(parts, cfs)
                if #parts == 0 then
                    return
                end
                pcall(workspace.BulkMoveTo, workspace, parts, cfs, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
            end
            local function folderGet()
                local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                if not cam then
                    return nil
                end
                if instance_9 and instance_9.Parent == cam then
                    return instance_9
                end
                if instance_9 then
                    pcall(function()
                        instance_9:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                pools = { orbs = {}, circle = {}, amb = {}, ghosts = {}, waves = {} }
                orbsStyle, ambStyle = nil, nil
                instance_9 = Instance.new("Folder")
                instance_9.Name = "NightCCVisuals"
                instance_9.Parent = cam
                return instance_9
            end
            local function killPool(key)
                for key_54, instance_10 in ipairs(pools[key]) do
                    if typeof(instance_10) == "Instance" then
                        pcall(function()
                            instance_10:Destroy()
                        end)
                    elseif instance_10.part then
                        pcall(function()
                            instance_10.part:Destroy()
                        end)
                    elseif instance_10.parts then
                        for key_55, instance_11 in ipairs(instance_10.parts) do
                            pcall(function()
                                instance_11:Destroy()
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end
                pools[key] = {}
            end
            local holoExtra = {}
            local function holoCapture(instance_12)
                holoOrig[instance_12] = { instance_12.Material, instance_12.Color, instance_12.Transparency }
                if instance_12:IsA("MeshPart") and instance_12.TextureID ~= "" then
                    holoExtra[#holoExtra + 1] = { "tex", p, instance_12.TextureID }
                    instance_12.TextureID = ""
                end
                for key_56, instance_13 in ipairs(instance_12:GetChildren()) do
                    if instance_13:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
                        holoExtra[#holoExtra + 1] = { "sa", c, p }
                        instance_13.Parent = nil
                    elseif instance_13:IsA("Decal") or instance_13:IsA("Texture") then
                        holoExtra[#holoExtra + 1] = { "decal", c, instance_13.Transparency }
                        instance_13.Transparency = 1
                    end
                end
            end
            local function holoApply(char, argument_173)
                if argument_173 >= holoAt then
                    holoAt = argument_173 + 1
                    for key_57, instance_14 in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                        if
                            instance_14:IsA("BasePart")
                            and instance_14.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart"
                            and holoOrig[instance_14] == nil
                            and instance_14.Transparency < 0.9
                        then
                            holoCapture(instance_14)
                        end
                    end
                end
                local flick = 0.05 * math.sin(argument_173 * 23)
                if math.sin(argument_173 * 3.1) > 0.9 then
                    flick = flick * 3
                end
                local result_60 = col(state_26.holoColor, argument_173, 0)
                for instance_15, item_37 in pairs(holoOrig) do
                    if instance_15.Parent then
                        instance_15.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
                        instance_15.Color = result_60
                        instance_15.Transparency = math.clamp(
                            math.max(item_37[3], state_26.holoAlpha + (1 - state_26.bright) * 0.3) + flick,
                            0,
                            0.95
                        )
                    end
                end
            end
            local function holoRestore()
                for instance_16, item_38 in pairs(holoOrig) do
                    if instance_16.Parent then
                        pcall(function()
                            instance_16.Material, instance_16.Color, instance_16.Transparency =
                                item_38[1], item_38[2], item_38[3]
                        end)
                    end
                    holoOrig[instance_16] = nil
                end
                for key_58, item_39 in ipairs(holoExtra) do
                    pcall(function()
                        if item_39[1] == "tex" then
                            item_39[2].TextureID = item_39[3]
                        elseif item_39[1] == "sa" then
                            item_39[2].Parent = item_39[3]
                        else
                            item_39[2].Transparency = item_39[3]
                        end
                    end)
                end
                holoExtra = {}
            end
            local function updateOrbs(argument_174, root, argument_175)
                local result_61 = math.clamp(math.floor(state_26.orbCount), 1, 16)
                local pool, style = pools.orbs, state_26.orbStyle
                if orbsStyle ~= style then
                    killPool("orbs")
                    pool = pools.orbs
                    orbsStyle = style
                end
                while #pool < result_61 do
                    local size = style == "Orbs" and Vector3.new(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
                        or style == "Cubes" and Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)
                        or style == "Diamonds" and Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
                        or Vector3.new(0.25, 0.25, 1.2)
                    local result_62 = mkPart(argument_174, size, state_26.orbColor, 0.05)
                    if style == "Orbs" then
                        result_62.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
                    end
                    pool[#pool + 1] = result_62
                end
                while #pool > result_61 do
                    local instance_17 = table.remove(pool)
                    pcall(function()
                        instance_17:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                local base = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
                local cfs = {}
                for key_59, item_40 in ipairs(pool) do
                    local computed_value_43 = argument_175 * state_26.orbSpeed
                        + (key_59 - 1) * (math.pi * 2 / result_61)
                    local pos = base
                        + Vector3.new(
                            math.cos(computed_value_43) * state_26.orbRadius,
                            math.sin(argument_175 * 1.3 + key_59) * 1.1,
                            math.sin(computed_value_43) * state_26.orbRadius
                        )
                    if style == "Shards" then
                        cfs[key_59] = CFrame.lookAt(pos, base)
                    elseif style == "Diamonds" then
                        cfs[key_59] = CFrame.new(pos)
                            * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(45), argument_175 * 1.2 + key_59, math.rad(45))
                    else
                        cfs[key_59] = CFrame.new(pos)
                            * CFrame.Angles(argument_175 * 1.5 + key_59, argument_175 * 1.1, key_59)
                    end
                    item_40.Color = col(state_26.orbColor, argument_175, key_59)
                    item_40.Transparency = helper_9(0.05)
                end
                bulk(pool, cfs)
            end
            local function updateCircle(argument_176, char, root, argument_177)
                local pool = pools.circle
                local OUT, INN = 28, 18
                local total = OUT + INN + 6
                while #pool < total do
                    pool[#pool + 1] =
                        mkPart(argument_176, Vector3.new(0.14, 0.05, 0.5), state_26.circleColor, 0.1)
                end
                local computed_value_44 = feetY(char, root) + 0.06
                local value_12, value_13 = root.Position.X, root.Position.Z
                local circle_size = state_26.circleSize
                local cfs, idx = {}, 0
                local function ring(argument_178, count, th0)
                    local chord = 2 * argument_178 * math.sin(math.pi / count) + 0.03
                    for index_20 = 0, count - 1 do
                        idx = idx + 1
                        local computed_value_45 = th0 + (math.pi * 2) * index_20 / count
                        local pos = Vector3.new(
                            value_12 + math.cos(computed_value_45) * argument_178,
                            computed_value_44,
                            value_13 + math.sin(computed_value_45) * argument_178
                        )
                        cfs[idx] = CFrame.lookAt(
                            pos,
                            pos + Vector3.new(-math.sin(computed_value_45), 0, math.cos(computed_value_45))
                        )
                        pool[idx].Size = Vector3.new(0.14, 0.05, chord)
                    end
                end
                ring(circle_size, OUT, argument_177 * 0.6)
                ring(circle_size * 0.72, INN, -argument_177 * 0.9)
                local computed_value_46, computed_value_47 = circle_size * 0.72, argument_177 * 0.6
                for index_21 = 0, 5 do
                    local computed_value_48, computed_value_49 =
                        computed_value_47 + index_21 * math.pi / 3,
                        computed_value_47 + (index_21 + 2) * math.pi / 3
                    local vector_3 = Vector3.new(
                        value_12 + math.cos(computed_value_48) * computed_value_46,
                        computed_value_44,
                        value_13 + math.sin(computed_value_48) * computed_value_46
                    )
                    local vector_4 = Vector3.new(
                        value_12 + math.cos(computed_value_49) * computed_value_46,
                        computed_value_44,
                        value_13 + math.sin(computed_value_49) * computed_value_46
                    )
                    idx = idx + 1
                    cfs[idx] = CFrame.lookAt((vector_3 + vector_4) / 2, vector_4)
                    pool[idx].Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.05, (vector_4 - vector_3).Magnitude)
                end
                for index_22 = 1, idx do
                    pool[index_22].Color = col(state_26.circleColor, argument_177, index_22 * 0.3)
                    pool[index_22].Transparency = helper_9(0.1)
                end
                bulk(pool, cfs)
            end
            local function updateAmbient(argument_179, char, root, argument_180, argument_181)
                local result_63 = math.clamp(math.floor(state_26.ambientAmount), 10, 150)
                local style = state_26.ambientStyle
                local pool = pools.amb
                if ambStyle ~= style then
                    killPool("amb")
                    pool = pools.amb
                    ambStyle = style
                end
                while #pool < result_63 do
                    local size = style == "Snow" and Vector3.new(0.16, 0.16, 0.16)
                        or style == "Petals" and Vector3.new(0.3, 0.03, 0.2)
                        or Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
                    local part_28 = mkPart(argument_179, size, state_26.ambientColor, 0.2)
                    if style == "Fireflies" or style == "Embers" or style == "Snow" then
                        part_28.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
                    end
                    pool[#pool + 1] =
                        { part = part_28, fresh = true, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0, ph = rng:NextNumber(0, 6.28) }
                end
                while #pool > result_63 do
                    local result_64 = table.remove(pool)
                    pcall(function()
                        result_64.part:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                local position_6 = root.Position
                local result_65 = feetY(char, root)
                local parts, cfs = {}, {}
                for key_60, item_41 in ipairs(pool) do
                    local computed_value_50, computed_value_51 =
                        item_41.x - position_6.X, item_41.z - position_6.Z
                    local out = item_41.fresh
                        or computed_value_50 * computed_value_50 + computed_value_51 * computed_value_51 > 324
                        or item_41.y < result_65 - 1
                        or item_41.y > result_65 + 12
                    if out then
                        local top = style == "Snow" or style == "Petals"
                        item_41.x, item_41.z =
                            position_6.X + rng:NextNumber(-16, 16), position_6.Z + rng:NextNumber(-16, 16)
                        if item_41.fresh then
                            item_41.y = result_65 + rng:NextNumber(0, 9)
                        elseif top then
                            item_41.y = result_65 + 9 + rng:NextNumber(0, 3)
                        elseif style == "Embers" then
                            item_41.y = result_65 + rng:NextNumber(0, 1)
                        else
                            item_41.y = result_65 + rng:NextNumber(0.5, 7)
                        end
                        item_41.fresh = false
                    end
                    local alpha, rot = 0.2, CFrame.identity
                    if style == "Fireflies" then
                        item_41.x = item_41.x + math.cos(argument_181 * 0.7 + item_41.ph) * 1.2 * argument_180
                        item_41.z = item_41.z
                            + math.sin(argument_181 * 0.9 + item_41.ph * 1.3) * 1.2 * argument_180
                        item_41.y = item_41.y + math.sin(argument_181 * 1.1 + item_41.ph) * 0.8 * argument_180
                        alpha = 0.15 + 0.75 * (0.5 - 0.5 * math.sin(argument_181 * 2.5 + item_41.ph))
                    elseif style == "Snow" then
                        item_41.y = item_41.y - 2.8 * argument_180
                        item_41.x = item_41.x + math.sin(argument_181 + item_41.ph) * 0.8 * argument_180
                        item_41.z = item_41.z + math.cos(argument_181 * 0.8 + item_41.ph) * 0.8 * argument_180
                        alpha = 0.1
                    elseif style == "Petals" then
                        item_41.y = item_41.y - 1.6 * argument_180
                        item_41.x = item_41.x + math.sin(argument_181 * 0.9 + item_41.ph) * 1.6 * argument_180
                        item_41.z = item_41.z + math.cos(argument_181 * 0.7 + item_41.ph) * 1.2 * argument_180
                        rot = CFrame.Angles(
                            argument_181 * 1.7 + item_41.ph,
                            argument_181 + item_41.ph,
                            argument_181 * 1.3
                        )
                        alpha = 0.1
                    else
                        item_41.y = item_41.y + 2.2 * argument_180
                        item_41.x = item_41.x + math.sin(argument_181 * 2 + item_41.ph) * 0.6 * argument_180
                        alpha = math.clamp((item_41.y - result_65) / 11, 0, 1) * 0.85
                            + 0.1 * math.sin(argument_181 * 12 + item_41.ph)
                    end
                    item_41.part.Transparency = math.clamp(helper_9(alpha), 0, 1)
                    item_41.part.Color = col(state_26.ambientColor, argument_181, key_60 * 0.05)
                    parts[key_60] = item_41.part
                    cfs[key_60] = CFrame.new(item_41.x, item_41.y, item_41.z) * rot
                end
                bulk(parts, cfs)
            end
            local function updateGhost(argument_182, char, root, argument_183)
                local ghosts = pools.ghosts
                for index_23 = #ghosts, 1, -1 do
                    local entry_12 = ghosts[index_23]
                    local computed_value_52 = (argument_183 - entry_12.t0) / state_26.ghostLife
                    if computed_value_52 >= 1 then
                        for key_61, instance_18 in ipairs(entry_12.parts) do
                            pcall(function()
                                instance_18:Destroy()
                            end)
                        end
                        table.remove(ghosts, index_23)
                    else
                        for key_62, item_42 in ipairs(entry_12.parts) do
                            item_42.Transparency = helper_9(0.45 + 0.55 * computed_value_52)
                        end
                    end
                end
                if argument_183 - lastGhost < 0.09 or #ghosts >= 10 then
                    return
                end
                local assembly_linear_velocity_3 = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                if
                    Vector3.new(assembly_linear_velocity_3.X, 0, assembly_linear_velocity_3.Z).Magnitude < 4
                then
                    return
                end
                lastGhost = argument_183
                local snap = { t0 = argument_183, parts = {} }
                local result_66 = col(state_26.ghostColor, argument_183, #ghosts)
                for key_63, instance_19 in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                    if
                        instance_19:IsA("BasePart")
                        and instance_19.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart"
                        and instance_19.Transparency < 0.9
                    then
                        local part_29 = mkPart(argument_182, instance_19.Size, result_66, 0.45)
                        part_29.CFrame = instance_19.CFrame
                        snap.parts[#snap.parts + 1] = part_29
                    end
                end
                ghosts[#ghosts + 1] = snap
            end
            local function spawnWave(argument_184, pos, maxD, argument_185)
                local state_28 = { t0 = argument_185, maxD = maxD, pos = pos, parts = {} }
                for index_24 = 1, 2 do
                    local result_67 = mkPart(
                        argument_184,
                        Vector3.new(0.12, 1, 1),
                        col(state_26.shockColor, argument_185, index_24),
                        0.3
                    )
                    result_67.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
                    state_28.parts[index_24] = result_67
                end
                pools.waves[#pools.waves + 1] = state_28
            end
            local function updateWaves(argument_186, char, root, argument_187)
                local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hum then
                    local onFloor = hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
                    local value_14 = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
                    local vector_5 = Vector3.new(root.Position.X, feetY(char, root) + 0.08, root.Position.Z)
                    if onFloor and not lastFloor and lastVy < -14 then
                        spawnWave(argument_186, vector_5, math.clamp(-lastVy * 0.45, 6, 22), argument_187)
                    elseif lastFloor and not onFloor and value_14 > 8 then
                        spawnWave(argument_186, vector_5, 6, argument_187)
                    end
                    lastFloor = onFloor
                    if not onFloor then
                        lastVy = value_14
                    end
                end
                local waves = pools.waves
                for index_25 = #waves, 1, -1 do
                    local entry_13 = waves[index_25]
                    local computed_value_53 = (argument_187 - entry_13.t0) / 0.55
                    if computed_value_53 >= 1 then
                        for key_64, instance_20 in ipairs(entry_13.parts) do
                            pcall(function()
                                instance_20:Destroy()
                            end)
                        end
                        table.remove(waves, index_25)
                    else
                        for key_65, part_30 in ipairs(entry_13.parts) do
                            local result_68 = math.clamp(computed_value_53 - (key_65 - 1) * 0.12, 0, 1)
                            local computed_value_54 = 1 + entry_13.maxD * result_68
                            part_30.Size = Vector3.new(0.12, computed_value_54, computed_value_54)
                            part_30.CFrame = CFrame.new(entry_13.pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)
                            part_30.Transparency = helper_9(0.25 + 0.75 * result_68)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local function updateLight(root, argument_188, argument_189)
                local night_cclight = root:FindFirstChild("NightCCLight")
                if argument_189 then
                    if not night_cclight then
                        night_cclight = Instance.new("PointLight")
                        night_cclight.Name = "NightCCLight"
                        night_cclight.Shadows = false
                        night_cclight.Parent = root
                    end
                    night_cclight.Color = col(state_26.lightColor, argument_188, 0)
                    night_cclight.Range = state_26.lightRange
                    night_cclight.Brightness = state_26.lightBright
                        * (0.4 + 0.6 * state_26.bright)
                        * (0.88 + 0.12 * math.sin(argument_188 * 3))
                elseif night_cclight then
                    night_cclight:Destroy()
                end
            end
            local GRADES = {
                Cyber = { tint = Color3.fromRGB(170, 200, 255), sat = 0.25, con = 0.12, bri = -0.02 },
                Sunset = { tint = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 160), sat = 0.2, con = 0.1, bri = 0 },
                Noir = { tint = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), sat = -1, con = 0.25, bri = -0.03 },
