            }
            local function effect(key, class, name)
                local instance_21 = state_27[key]
                if instance_21 and instance_21.Parent then
                    return instance_21
                end
                instance_21 = Instance.new(class)
                instance_21.Name = name
                instance_21.Parent = Lighting_
                state_27[key] = instance_21
                return instance_21
            end
            local function dropEffect(key)
                local instance_22 = state_27[key]
                if instance_22 then
                    pcall(function()
                        instance_22:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                state_27[key] = nil
            end
            local function updateCinema()
                if state_26.bloom then
                    local result_69 = effect("bloom", "BloomEffect", "NightCCBloom")
                    result_69.Intensity, result_69.Size, result_69.Threshold = state_26.bloomInt, 28, 0.9
                else
                    dropEffect("bloom")
                end
                if state_26.rays then
                    local result_70 = effect("rays", "SunRaysEffect", "NightCCRays")
                    result_70.Intensity, result_70.Spread = state_26.raysInt, 0.6
                else
                    dropEffect("rays")
                end
                local entry_14 = GRADES[state_26.grade]
                if entry_14 then
                    local result_71 = effect("grade", "ColorCorrectionEffect", "NightCCGrade")
                    local grade_int = state_26.gradeInt
                    result_71.TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1):Lerp(entry_14.tint, grade_int)
                    result_71.Saturation, result_71.Contrast, result_71.Brightness =
                        entry_14.sat * grade_int, entry_14.con * grade_int, entry_14.bri * grade_int
                else
                    dropEffect("grade")
                end
            end
            local function anyOn()
                return state_26.holo
                    or state_26.orbs
                    or state_26.circle
                    or state_26.ambient
                    or state_26.ghost
                    or state_26.shock
                    or state_26.light
            end
            local function clearAll()
                holoRestore()
                if instance_9 then
                    pcall(function()
                        instance_9:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                instance_9 = nil
                pools = { orbs = {}, circle = {}, amb = {}, ghosts = {}, waves = {} }
                orbsStyle, ambStyle = nil, nil
                local char = LP_.Character
                local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local instance_23 = root and root:FindFirstChild("NightCCLight")
                if instance_23 then
                    instance_23:Destroy()
                end
            end
            avRuntime.connect(RunService_.RenderStepped, function(argument_190)
                if not anyOn() then
                    if active then
                        clearAll()
                        active = false
                    end
                    return
                end
                local char, root = bodyParts()
                if not char or char:GetAttribute("Dead") == true then
                    if active then
                        clearAll()
                        active = false
                    end
                    return
                end
                local result_72 = folderGet()
                if not result_72 then
                    return
                end
                active = true
                local result_73 = os.clock()
                if state_26.holo then
                    holoApply(char, result_73)
                elseif next(holoOrig) ~= nil then
                    holoRestore()
                end
                if state_26.orbs then
                    updateOrbs(result_72, root, result_73)
                elseif #pools.orbs > 0 then
                    killPool("orbs")
                end
                if state_26.circle then
                    updateCircle(result_72, char, root, result_73)
                elseif #pools.circle > 0 then
                    killPool("circle")
                end
                if state_26.ambient then
                    updateAmbient(result_72, char, root, argument_190, result_73)
                elseif #pools.amb > 0 then
                    killPool("amb")
                end
                if state_26.ghost then
                    updateGhost(result_72, char, root, result_73)
                elseif #pools.ghosts > 0 then
                    killPool("ghosts")
                end
                if state_26.shock then
                    updateWaves(result_72, char, root, result_73)
                elseif #pools.waves > 0 then
                    killPool("waves")
                end
                updateLight(root, result_73, state_26.light)
            end)
            avRuntime.teardown(function()
                state_26.holo, state_26.orbs, state_26.circle, state_26.ambient, state_26.ghost, state_26.shock, state_26.light =
                    false, false, false, false, false, false, false
                state_26.bloom, state_26.rays, state_26.grade = false, false, "Off"
                pcall(clearAll)
                pcall(updateCinema)
            end)

module_registry.shot_origin = function()
    local player = module_registry.load("roblox_services").lp
    return {
        origin = function(camera)
            local viewport_size = camera.ViewportSize
            local origin, character =
                camera:ViewportPointToRay(viewport_size.X * 0.5, viewport_size.Y * 0.5).Origin,
                player.Character
            if not character then
                return origin, false
            end
            camera = nil
            viewport_size = character:FindFirstChild("CameraPart")
            if viewport_size and (viewport_size:IsA("BasePart")) then
                camera = viewport_size.Position
            else
                local head_2 = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
                if head_2 and (head_2:IsA("BasePart")) then
                    camera = head_2.Position
                else
                    local humanoid_root_part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    camera = if humanoid_root_part
                        then if humanoid_root_part:IsA("BasePart")
                            then humanoid_root_part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0)
                            else camera
                        else camera
                end
            end
            if not camera then
                return origin, false
            end
            if (camera - origin).Magnitude > 1 then
                return camera, true
            end
            return camera, false
        end,
    }
end

    local math_abs = math.abs

        return math_clamp(tonumber(argument) or 0, 0, 1)
    end

        argument_2 = helper(argument_2)
        return argument_2 * argument_2 * (3 - 2 * argument_2)
    end
    local function helper_3(argument_3, argument_4)
        local result = helper_2(math_min(argument_4, 1 - argument_4) / 0.18)
        local computed_value, computed_value_2 = 0.004 + result ^ 2.6 * 0.996, result ^ 1.25
        result, argument_4 = argument_3 / (0.26 * computed_value), argument_3 / (0.8 * computed_value)
        computed_value = helper(computed_value_2 * math_exp(-(result * result) * 2.66)) * 0.98
        return computed_value
            + helper(computed_value_2 * math_exp(-(argument_4 * argument_4) * 2.66))
                * 0.4
                * (1 - computed_value)
    end

module_registry.movement_lock_state = function()
    local os_clock, movement_lock_state_api =
        os.clock, {
            hooked = false,
            on = false,
            fresh = false,
            broke = false,
            target = nil,
            beat = 0,
            samples = 0,
            still = 0,
            ground = false,
            bx = 0,
            by = 0,
            bj = false,
            input_at = 0,
        }
    movement_lock_state_api.engage = function(argument)
        if not movement_lock_state_api.on then
            movement_lock_state_api.on = true
            movement_lock_state_api.fresh = true
            movement_lock_state_api.broke = false
            movement_lock_state_api.samples = 0
            movement_lock_state_api.still = 0
            movement_lock_state_api.ground = false
        end
        movement_lock_state_api.target = argument
        movement_lock_state_api.beat = os_clock()
    end
    movement_lock_state_api.release = function()
        movement_lock_state_api.on = false
        movement_lock_state_api.fresh = false
        movement_lock_state_api.broke = false
        movement_lock_state_api.target = nil
        movement_lock_state_api.samples = 0
        movement_lock_state_api.still = 0
        movement_lock_state_api.ground = false
    end
    movement_lock_state_api.active = function(argument_2)
        if not movement_lock_state_api.on then
            return false
        end
        if argument_2 - movement_lock_state_api.beat > 0.5 then
            movement_lock_state_api.release()
            return false
        end
        return true
    end
    return movement_lock_state_api
end

module_registry.command_aim_state = function()
    local command_aim_state_api =
        { weapon = nil, cframe = nil, yaw = 0, pitch = 0, expires = 0, cmd_samples = 0 }
    command_aim_state_api.cmd_active = function(argument)
        argument = argument or os.clock()
        if command_aim_state_api.cmd_samples <= 0 then
            return false
        elseif argument > command_aim_state_api.expires then
            return false
        end
        if type(command_aim_state_api.yaw) ~= "number" then
            return false
        elseif type(command_aim_state_api.pitch) ~= "number" then
            return false
        end
        return true
    end
    command_aim_state_api.cmd_consume = function()
        if command_aim_state_api.cmd_samples > 0 then
            command_aim_state_api.cmd_samples = command_aim_state_api.cmd_samples - 1
        end
    end
    command_aim_state_api.clear = function()
        command_aim_state_api.weapon = nil
        command_aim_state_api.cframe = nil
        command_aim_state_api.yaw = 0
        command_aim_state_api.pitch = 0
        command_aim_state_api.expires = 0
        command_aim_state_api.cmd_samples = 0
    end
    return command_aim_state_api
end

module_registry.weapon_timing = function()
    local roblox_services = module_registry.load("roblox_services")
    local result, weapon_timing_api =
        roblox_services.module(roblox_services.storage, "Components", "Common", "WeaponTimings"), {}
    weapon_timing_api.last = roblox_services.weak()
    weapon_timing_api.global_last = 0
    weapon_timing_api.min_interval = function(argument)
        local number_value = 0.05
        if type(argument) ~= "table" then
            return number_value
        end
        if type(result) == "table" then
            if type(result.MinShotInterval) == "function" then
                local ok_2, value_2 = pcall(result.MinShotInterval, argument)
                number_value = if ok_2
                    then if type(value_2) == "number"
                        then if value_2 > 0
                            then if value_2 < math.huge
                                then if value_2 > number_value then value_2 else number_value
                                else number_value
                            else number_value
                        else number_value
                    else number_value
            end
        end
        local number_value_2 = tonumber(argument.FireRate)
        number_value = if number_value_2
            then if number_value_2 > 0
                then if number_value_2 > number_value then number_value_2 else number_value
                else number_value
            else number_value
        number_value_2 = argument.FireModes
        if type(number_value_2) == "table" then
            argument = number_value_2.Primary
            if type(argument) == "table" then
                local number_value_3 = tonumber(argument.FireRate)
                number_value = if number_value_3
                    then if number_value_3 > 0
                        then if number_value_3 < number_value then number_value_3 else number_value
                        else number_value
                    else number_value
            end
            local secondary = number_value_2.Secondary
            if type(secondary) == "table" then
                local number_value_4 = tonumber(secondary.FireRate)
                number_value = if number_value_4
                    then if number_value_4 > 0
                        then if number_value_4 < number_value then number_value_4 else number_value
                        else number_value
                    else number_value
            end
        end
        return if number_value < 0.05 then 0.05 else number_value
    end
    weapon_timing_api.wait = function(weapon, argument_2, argument_3)
        argument_3 = argument_3 or os.clock()
        local selected_value = if argument_2 == nil
            then if weapon then weapon.Properties else argument_2
            else argument_2
        local result_2, global_last =
            weapon_timing_api.min_interval(selected_value), weapon_timing_api.global_last
        if weapon then
            argument_2 = weapon_timing_api.last[weapon]
            global_last = if argument_2
                then if argument_2 > global_last then argument_2 else global_last
                else global_last
        end
        weapon = global_last + result_2 - argument_3
        if weapon > 0 then
            return weapon
        end
        return 0
    end
    weapon_timing_api.ready = function(argument_4, argument_5, argument_6)
        return weapon_timing_api.wait(argument_4, argument_5, argument_6) <= 0
    end
    weapon_timing_api.mark = function(argument_7, argument_8)
        argument_8 = argument_8 or os.clock()
        if argument_7 then
            weapon_timing_api.last[argument_7] = argument_8
        end
        weapon_timing_api.global_last = argument_8
    end
    weapon_timing_api.clear = function(argument_9)
        if argument_9 then
            weapon_timing_api.last[argument_9] = nil
        end
    end
    return weapon_timing_api
end

    local function helper_12(argument_41, vector_4, argument_42)
        local magnitude_3 = vector_4.Magnitude
        if magnitude_3 < 0.25 then
            return nil
        end
        local result_10 = probe(argument_41, vector_4, raycast_params, argument_42)
        if not result_10.instance then

        if argument_42 < 0.25 then

        return argument_41 + vector_4 * (argument_42 / magnitude_3)
    end
    local function helper_13(argument_43, argument_44, argument_45, argument_46, argument_47)
        local scanOn = aim_settings.origin_scan == true
        local maxPts = scanOn and 24 or 5
        local computed_value_17, entry_6 = (argument_43 - 1) * maxPts, state_19[argument_43]
        if entry_6 then
            return computed_value_17, entry_6
        end
        local vector_5 = Vector3.new(argument_45.X - argument_44.X, 0, argument_45.Z - argument_44.Z)
        local fwd, right
        if vector_5.Magnitude > 0.001 then
            fwd = vector_5.Unit
            right = Vector3.new(-fwd.Z, 0, fwd.X)
        else
            fwd = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
            right = zero
        end
        local vector_6 = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        entry_6 = 0
        local function push(argument_48)
            if not argument_48 then
                return
            end
            for index_13 = 1, entry_6, 1 do
                if (state_18[computed_value_17 + index_13] - argument_48).Magnitude < 0.2 then
                    return
                end
            end
            if entry_6 >= maxPts then
                return
            end
            entry_6 += 1
            state_18[computed_value_17 + entry_6] = argument_48
        end
        if argument_47 and argument_47 >= 0.25 then
            local half = argument_47 * 0.5
            push(helper_12(argument_44, right * half, argument_46))
            push(helper_12(argument_44, right * -half, argument_46))
            push(helper_12(argument_44, right * argument_47, argument_46))
            push(helper_12(argument_44, right * -argument_47, argument_46))
            push(helper_12(argument_44, vector_6 * argument_47, argument_46))
        end
        if scanOn then
            local rad = math.clamp(tonumber(aim_settings.origin_scan_radius) or 8, 1, 16)
            local steps = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(aim_settings.origin_scans) or 6), 3, 12)
            local mode = tostring(aim_settings.origin_scan_mode or "optimized")
            local rings = { 0.35, 0.6, 0.85, 1.0 }
            if mode == "precise" then
                rings = { 0.25, 0.45, 0.65, 0.85, 1.0 }
            end
            for index_14 = 1, #rings do
                local result_11 = math.max(rad * rings[index_14], 0.8)
                for index_15 = 1, steps do
                    local ang = ((index_15 - 1) / steps) * math.pi * 2
                    local off = right * math.cos(ang) * result_11 + fwd * math.sin(ang) * result_11 * 0.35
                    push(helper_12(argument_44, off, argument_46))
                    if entry_6 >= maxPts then
                        break
                    end
                end
                if entry_6 >= maxPts then
                    break
                end
            end
            push(helper_12(argument_44, vector_6 * math.min(rad * 0.5, 2.5), argument_46))
            push(helper_12(argument_44, vector_6 * -math.min(rad * 0.35, 1.8), argument_46))
            push(helper_12(argument_44, fwd * math.max(rad * 0.3, 1.5), argument_46))
            push(
                helper_12(
                    argument_44,
                    fwd * math.max(rad * 0.55, 2.5) + right * math.max(rad * 0.25, 1.2),
                    argument_46
                )
            )
            push(
                helper_12(
                    argument_44,
                    fwd * math.max(rad * 0.55, 2.5) + right * -math.max(rad * 0.25, 1.2),
                    argument_46
                )
            )
        end
        state_19[argument_43] = entry_6
        return computed_value_17, entry_6
    end

                return
            end
        else
            return
        end

            properties_2.ShootingOptions == "Revolver", aim_settings.auto_revolver

            if auto_revolver then aim_settings.auto_switch else not auto_revolver, false

module_registry.aim_fov_overlay = function()
    local roblox_services, lifecycle, fov_circle_renderer, aim_settings =

    local weapon_profiles = module_registry.load("weapon_profiles")

    local math_tan = math.tan
    local math_rad = math.rad
    local result = fov_circle_renderer.new(999)
    local function helper()

        if weapon then

    end
    roblox_services = {
        step = function()
            if aim_settings.on then
                if aim_settings.draw_fov then
                    if not (helper()) then
                        result:hide()
                        return
                    end
                else
                    result:hide()
                    return
                end
            else
                result:hide()
                return
            end
            local current_camera = workspace_2.CurrentCamera
            if not current_camera then
                return
            end
            local number_value = tonumber(aim_settings.fov) or 0
            if number_value <= 0 then
                result:hide()
                return
            elseif number_value >= 360 then
                result:hide()
                return
            end
            local viewport_size = current_camera.ViewportSize
            local computed_value = math_tan(math_rad(number_value * 0.5))
                * (viewport_size.Y * 0.5)
                / math_tan(math_rad(current_camera.FieldOfView * 0.5))
            result:show(viewport_size.X * 0.5, viewport_size.Y * 0.5, computed_value, aim_settings)
        end,
        unload = function()
            result:destroy()
        end,
    }
    lifecycle.teardown(roblox_services.unload)
    return roblox_services
end

module_registry.trigger_profiles = function()
    local lifecycle, weapon_profiles =
        module_registry.load("lifecycle"), module_registry.load("weapon_profiles")
    local trigger_settings, trigger_profiles_api =
        module_registry.load("trigger_settings"), { active = nil, weapon = nil, ui = nil }
    trigger_profiles_api.apply = function(argument)

        if not value_2 then

        end

        end

        trigger_settings.auto_switch = computed_value and helper("autoswitch") or false

        trigger_settings.min_damage = helper("mindmg")
        trigger_settings.wall_min_damage = helper("awmindmg")

        trigger_settings.draw_fov = computed_value and helper("dfov") or false

module_registry.trigger_fov_overlay = function()
    local roblox_services, lifecycle, fov_circle_renderer, trigger_settings =
        module_registry.load("roblox_services"),
        module_registry.load("lifecycle"),
        module_registry.load("fov_circle_renderer"),
        module_registry.load("trigger_settings")
    local spread_geometry = module_registry.load("spread_geometry")
    local workspace_2 = roblox_services.workspace
    local math_tan = math.tan
    local math_rad = math.rad
    local math_max = math.max
    local result = fov_circle_renderer.new(999)
    fov_circle_renderer = {
        step = function()
            if trigger_settings.on then
                if trigger_settings.draw_fov then
                    if not spread_geometry.ok then
                        result:hide()
                        return
                    end
                else
                    result:hide()
                    return
                end
            else
                result:hide()
                return
            end
            local current_camera = workspace_2.CurrentCamera
            if not current_camera then
                return
            end
            local viewport_size = current_camera.ViewportSize
            local computed_value, computed_value_2, computed_value_3, result_2 =
                math_tan(spread_geometry.half) * (viewport_size.Y * 0.5) / math_tan(
                    math_rad(current_camera.FieldOfView * 0.5)
                ),
                viewport_size.X * 0.5,
                viewport_size.Y * 0.5,
                current_camera:WorldToViewportPoint(spread_geometry.origin + spread_geometry.dir * 100)
            if result_2.Z > 0 then
                computed_value_2, computed_value_3 = result_2.X, result_2.Y
            end
            result:show(computed_value_2, computed_value_3, math_max(computed_value, 2), trigger_settings)
        end,
        unload = function()
            result:destroy()
        end,
    }
    lifecycle.teardown(fov_circle_renderer.unload)
    return fov_circle_renderer
end

module_registry.viewmodel_overrides = function()
    local roblox_services = module_registry.load("roblox_services")
    local feature_settings, lifecycle =
        module_registry.load("feature_settings"), module_registry.load("lifecycle")
    local game_bindings, world = module_registry.load("game_bindings"), feature_settings.world
    local local_player = roblox_services.lp
    local inventory = game_bindings.inventory
    local char_resolver = game_bindings.char_resolver
    local crosshair = game_bindings.crosshair
    local runstep, state_2, state_3, value_2, value_3 = game_bindings.runstep, {}, {}
    local enabled, value_4, value_5 = false
    local number_value = 0
    local function helper()
        if world.force_xhair then
            if not (char_resolver.isAliveCharacter(local_player.Character)) then
                return
            end
        else
            return
        end
        local weapon = inventory.peekCurrentEquippedForMovement()
        local index = type(weapon) == "table" and rawget(weapon, "Properties")
        if type(index) ~= "table" then
            return
        elseif weapon.IsEquipped ~= true then
            return
        elseif index.Class ~= "Weapon" then
            return
        elseif index.ShowCrosshair ~= false then
            return
        end
        local entry = state_2[index]
        if entry then
        else
            entry = table.freeze(setmetatable({ ShowCrosshair = true }, { __index = index }))
            state_2[index] = entry
        end
        rawset(weapon, "Properties", entry)
        value_2, value_3 = weapon, index
    end
    local function helper_2()
        local value_6, value_7 = value_2, value_3
        if not value_6 then
            return
        end
        value_2, value_3 = nil, nil
        if rawget(value_6, "Properties") == state_2[value_7] then
            rawset(value_6, "Properties", value_7)
        end
    end
    local function helper_3(argument)
        if value_5 then
            local value_8 = value_5
            return value_8
        end
        if type(argument) ~= "function" then
            return nil
        end
        local callback = function(...)
            local run, enter, leave, guard, raise = ...
            return function(...)
                guard(enter)
                local result, err = guard(run, ...)
                guard(leave)
                if not result then
                    raise(err, 0)
                end
            end
        end
        if type(callback) ~= "function" then
            return nil
        end
        setfenv(callback, {})
        local value_9
        value_9, value_4 = callback(argument, helper, helper_2, pcall, error), argument
        value_5 = value_9
        callback = value_5
        return callback
    end
    local function helper_4()
        local computed_value, get_upvalues =
            type(runstep) == "table" and rawget(runstep, "Unbind"), roblox_services.getups
        if type(computed_value) ~= "function" then
            return nil
        elseif type(get_upvalues) ~= "function" then
            return nil
        end
        local ok_2, value_10 = pcall(get_upvalues, computed_value)
        if ok_2 then
            if type(value_10) ~= "table" then
                return nil
            end
        else
            return nil
        end
        for key_2, item in value_10, nil, nil do
            computed_value = type(item) == "table" and rawget(item, "RenderStepped")
            item = type(computed_value) == "table" and rawget(computed_value, "BindingsByName")
            if type(item) == "table" then
                return item
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function helper_5()
        if not value_5 then
            return
        end
        local result_2 = helper_4()
        local computed_value_2 = result_2 and rawget(result_2, "UI.Crosshair.Update")
        if type(computed_value_2) ~= "table" then
            return
        elseif computed_value_2.Callback == value_5 then
            return
        elseif type(computed_value_2.Callback) ~= "function" then
            return
        end
        computed_value_2.Callback = value_5
        if not state_3[computed_value_2] then
            state_3[computed_value_2] = true
            lifecycle.teardown(function()
                if computed_value_2.Callback == value_5 then
                    computed_value_2.Callback = value_4
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    local function helper_6()
        if enabled then
            return
        elseif type(crosshair) ~= "table" then
            return
        elseif type(setfenv) ~= "function" then
            return
        end
        enabled = true
        lifecycle.field(crosshair, "UpdateCrosshair", helper_3)
        helper_5()
        lifecycle.connect(roblox_services.run.Heartbeat, function()
            if not world.force_xhair then
                return
            end
            local result_3 = os.clock()
            if result_3 < number_value then
                return
            end
            number_value = result_3 + 1
            helper_5()
        end)
    end
    feature_settings = {
        set = function(argument_2)
            world.force_xhair = argument_2 == true
            if world.force_xhair then
                helper_6()
            end
        end,
    }
    lifecycle.teardown(function()
        world.force_xhair = false
        helper_2()
        table.clear(state_2)
    end)
    return feature_settings
end

            flag = "legit.hb",
            multi = true,
            values = order,
            default = {
                "head",
                "chest",
            },
            cb = refresh,
        })
        :dep(hitbox_groups)
    weapon_profiles
        :dropdown({ name = "prefer", flag = "legit.prefer", values = order, default = "head", cb = refresh })
        :dep(hitbox_groups)
    weapon_profiles
        :slider({
            name = "fov",
            flag = "legit.fov",
            min = 0,
            max = 600,
            default = 600,
            suffix = "\194\176",
            cb = refresh,
        })
        :dep(hitbox_groups)

    aim:slider({
        name = "force origin",
        flag = "legit.originshift",
        min = 0,
        max = 8,
        dec = 1,
        zero = "off",
        suffix = "st",
        cb = refresh,
    }):dep(hitbox_groups)
    aim:toggle({ name = "origin scan", flag = "legit.originscan", cb = refresh }):dep(hitbox_groups)
    aim:slider({
        name = "origin range",
        flag = "legit.originscanradius",
        min = 1,
        max = 16,
        default = 8,
        suffix = "st",
        cb = refresh,
    }):dep(hitbox_groups)
    aim:slider({
        name = "origin scans",
        flag = "legit.originscans",
        min = 3,
        max = 12,
        default = 6,
        cb = refresh,
    }):dep(hitbox_groups)
    aim:dropdown({
        name = "scan style",
        flag = "legit.originscanmode",
        values = { "optimized", "precise", "default" },
        default = "optimized",
        cb = refresh,
    }):dep(hitbox_groups)
    interface_root:toggle({ name = "no recoil", flag = "legit.norecoil", cb = refresh })
    interface_root:toggle({ name = "no spread", flag = "legit.nospread", cb = refresh })
    interface_root:toggle({ name = "insta reload", flag = "legit.instantreload", cb = refresh })
    do
        local state_2 = { on = false, mult = 2, unlimited = false, last = 0 }
        local lib = module_registry.load("lifecycle")
        local inv = module_registry.load("character_state").inventory
        local run_service, UIS, LPl =
            game:GetService("RunService"),
            game:GetService("UserInputService"),
            game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        interface_root:toggle({
            name = "speed shoot",
            flag = "legit.rapid",
            cb = function(argument)
                state_2.on = argument == true
            end,
        })
        interface_root:slider({
            name = "speed shoot rate",
            flag = "legit.rapidmult",
            min = 1,
            max = 10,
            default = 2,
            suffix = "x",
            cb = function(argument_2)
                state_2.mult = tonumber(argument_2) or 2
            end,
        })
        interface_root:toggle({
            name = "speed shoot unlimited",
            flag = "legit.rapidunl",
            cb = function(argument_3)
                state_2.unlimited = argument_3 == true
            end,
        })
        lib.connect(run_service.Heartbeat, function()
            if not state_2.on then
                return
            end
            if LPl:GetAttribute("IsPlayerChatting") or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() ~= nil then
                return
            end
            if type(inv) ~= "table" or type(inv.peekCurrentEquippedForMovement) ~= "function" then
                return
            end
            local ok_2, weapon = pcall(inv.peekCurrentEquippedForMovement)
            if not ok_2 or type(weapon) ~= "table" or weapon.IsDestroyed or weapon.IsEquipped == false then
                return
            end
            if not weapon.Bullet or type(weapon.Properties) ~= "table" then
                return
            end
            if weapon.IsFireHeld ~= true or (weapon.Rounds or 0) <= 0 or weapon.IsReloading then
                return
            end
            local rate = tonumber(weapon.Properties.FireRate) or 0.1
            local gap = state_2.unlimited and 0 or rate / math.max(state_2.mult, 1)
            if os.clock() - state_2.last < gap then
                return
            end
            if weapon.ShootDelayThread then
                pcall(task.cancel, weapon.ShootDelayThread)
            end
            weapon.ShootDelayThread = nil
            weapon.IsShooting = false
            weapon.NextShotDue = 0
            state_2.last = os.clock()
            if mouse1release then
                mouse1release()
            end
            if mouse1press then
                mouse1press()
            end
        end)
    end
    player_selection.refresh()
    return true
end

module_registry.trigger_settings_interface = function()
    local interface_root, hitbox_groups, weapon_profiles, trigger_profiles, color_2 =
        module_registry.load("interface_root"),
        module_registry.load("hitbox_groups"),
        module_registry.load("weapon_profiles"),
        module_registry.load("trigger_profiles"),
        Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    local order, refresh, trigger = hitbox_groups.order, trigger_profiles.refresh, interface_root.tabs.trigger
    interface_root = trigger:profile({ id = "trigger", items = weapon_profiles.names, global = "global" })
    interface_root.cb = refresh
    trigger_profiles.ui = interface_root
    interface_root, trigger_profiles =
        trigger:section({ name = "trigger bot" }), trigger:section({ name = "accuracy", side = 2 })
    weapon_profiles = interface_root:toggle({ name = "enable", flag = "trig.on", cb = refresh })
    interface_root
        :toggle({ name = "team check", flag = "trig.team", default = true, cb = refresh })
        :dep(weapon_profiles)
    interface_root
        :toggle({ name = "auto revolver", flag = "trig.autorev", cb = refresh })
        :dep(weapon_profiles)
        :settings()
        :toggle({ name = "auto switch", flag = "trig.autoswitch", cb = refresh })
    interface_root
        :dropdown({
            name = "hitboxes",
            flag = "trig.hb",
            multi = true,
            values = order,
            default = { "head", "chest", "stomach", "arms" },
            cb = refresh,
        })
        :dep(weapon_profiles)
    interface_root
        :dropdown({ name = "prefer", flag = "trig.prefer", values = order, default = "head", cb = refresh })
        :dep(weapon_profiles)
    trigger =
        interface_root:toggle({ name = "draw fov", flag = "trig.dfov", cb = refresh }):dep(weapon_profiles)
    trigger:color({ flag = "trig.dfov_col", default = color_2, cb = refresh })
    hitbox_groups = trigger:settings()
    hitbox_groups
        :toggle({ name = "gradient", flag = "trig.dfov_grad", cb = refresh })
        :color({ flag = "trig.dfov_col2", default = color_2, cb = refresh })
    hitbox_groups
        :toggle({ name = "fill", flag = "trig.dfov_fill", cb = refresh })
        :color({ flag = "trig.dfov_fcol", default = color_2, cb = refresh })
    hitbox_groups
        :toggle({ name = "fill gradient", flag = "trig.dfov_fgrad", cb = refresh })
        :color({ flag = "trig.dfov_fcol2", default = color_2, cb = refresh })
    trigger_profiles
        :slider({ name = "min damage", flag = "trig.mindmg", min = 0, max = 150, cb = refresh })
        :dep(weapon_profiles)
    trigger_profiles
        :slider({
            name = "hit chance",
            flag = "trig.hc",
            min = 1,
            max = 100,
            default = 70,
            suffix = "%",
            cb = refresh,
        })
        :dep(weapon_profiles)
    trigger_profiles
        :toggle({ name = "auto wall", flag = "trig.aw", cb = refresh })
        :dep(weapon_profiles)
        :settings()
        :slider({ name = "min damage", flag = "trig.awmindmg", min = 0, max = 150, cb = refresh })
    return true
end

module_registry.music_interface = function()
    local interface_root = module_registry.load("interface_root")
    local Players_ = game:GetService("Players")
    local LP_ = Players_.LocalPlayer
    local page = interface_root.tabs.misc:page("music")
    local sec = page:section({ name = "music player" })
    local state = { soundId = "", sound = nil, volume = 50, loop = false }
    local function stopSound()
        if state.sound then
            pcall(function()
                state.sound:Stop()
            end)
            pcall(function()
                state.sound:Destroy()
            end)
            state.sound = nil
        end
    end
    local function parseId(raw)
        local digits = tostring(raw or ""):match("%d+")
        return digits
    end
    local function playSound()
        local result = parseId(state.soundId)
        if not result then
            return
        end
        stopSound()
        local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
        snd.Name = "NightCCMusic"
        snd.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. result
        snd.Volume = state.volume / 100
        snd.Looped = state.loop
        snd.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")
        snd:Play()
        state.sound = snd
    end
    sec:input({
        name = "sound id",
        flag = "music.id",
        placeholder = "rbxassetid number or link",
        cb = function(argument)
            state.soundId = tostring(argument or "")
        end,
    })
    sec:slider({
        name = "volume",
        flag = "music.vol",
        min = 0,
        max = 100,
        default = 50,
        suffix = "%",
        cb = function(argument_2)
            state.volume = tonumber(argument_2) or 50
            if state.sound then
                state.sound.Volume = state.volume / 100
            end
        end,
    })
    sec:toggle({
        name = "loop",
        flag = "music.loop",
        cb = function(argument_3)
            state.loop = argument_3 == true
            if state.sound then
                state.sound.Looped = state.loop
            end
        end,
    })
    sec:button({ name = "play", cb = playSound })
    sec:button({
        name = "pause / resume",
        cb = function()
            if state.sound then
                if state.sound.Playing then
                    state.sound:Pause()
                else
                    state.sound:Resume()
                end
            end
        end,
    })
    sec:button({ name = "stop", cb = stopSound })
    pcall(function()
        getgenv().__nightccUnloadMusic = stopSound
        local prev = getgenv().__nightccUnload
        getgenv().__nightccUnload = function()
            pcall(stopSound)
            if type(prev) == "function" then
                pcall(prev)
            end
        end
    end)
    local secBody = page:section({ name = "body fire", side = 2 })
    local RunService_ = game:GetService("RunService")
    local glow = { on = false, size = 8, fire = nil, root = nil }
    local function destroyGlow()
        if glow.fire then
            pcall(function()
                glow.fire:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        glow.fire, glow.root = nil, nil
    end
    local function ensureGlow()
        local char = LP_.Character
        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then
            destroyGlow()
            return
        end
        if glow.root == root and glow.fire and glow.fire.Parent then
            return
        end
        destroyGlow()
        local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
        fire.Name = "NightCCBodyFire"
        fire.Heat = 10
        fire.Size = glow.size
        fire.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        fire.SecondaryColor = Color3.fromRGB(190, 210, 255)
        fire.Parent = root
        glow.fire, glow.root = fire, root
    end
    RunService_.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not glow.on then
            if glow.fire then
                destroyGlow()
            end
            return
        end
        ensureGlow()
        if glow.fire then
            glow.fire.Size = glow.size
        end
    end)
    secBody:toggle({
        name = "body fire",
        flag = "fx.bodyfire",
        cb = function(argument_4)
            glow.on = argument_4 == true
            if not glow.on then
                destroyGlow()
            end
        end,
    })
    secBody:slider({
        name = "fire size",
        flag = "fx.bodyfiresize",
        min = 2,
        max = 20,
        default = 8,
        cb = function(argument_5)
            glow.size = tonumber(argument_5) or 8
        end,
    })
    pcall(function()
        local prev = getgenv().__nightccUnload
        getgenv().__nightccUnload = function()
            pcall(destroyGlow)
            if type(prev) == "function" then
                pcall(prev)
            end
        end
    end)
    return true
end

module_registry.spectator_list = function()
    local roblox_services, lifecycle =
        module_registry.load("roblox_services"), module_registry.load("lifecycle")
    local interface_root, local_player = module_registry.load("interface_root"), roblox_services.lp
    local players_service = roblox_services.players
    local workspace_2 = roblox_services.workspace
    local lib_2 = interface_root.lib
    local string_lower = string.lower
    local math_max = math.max
    local math_floor, state_2, enabled = math.floor, {}, false
    local function helper(instance, instance_2)
        local computed_value = instance:GetAttribute("LastKiller") == local_player.Name
        if computed_value ~= (instance_2:GetAttribute("LastKiller") == local_player.Name) then
            return computed_value
        end
        return string_lower(instance.DisplayName .. "\0" .. instance.Name)
            < string_lower(instance_2.DisplayName .. "\0" .. instance_2.Name)
    end
    local function helper_2()
        local state_3, result =
            {}, math_max(0, math_floor(tonumber(local_player:GetAttribute("Spectators")) or 0))
        if result == 0 then
            return state_3
        end
        local result_2, computed_value_2 =
            local_player:GetAttribute("Team"), workspace_2:GetAttribute("ServerGamemode") == "Competitive"
        for key_2, instance_3 in players_service:GetPlayers() do
            if instance_3 ~= local_player then
                if instance_3.Parent == players_service then
                    if instance_3:GetAttribute("IsSpectating") == true then
                        if computed_value_2 then
                            if result_2 then
                                if result_2 == "Spectators" then
                                    state_3[#state_3 + 1] = instance_3
                                elseif instance_3:GetAttribute("Team") == result_2 then
                                    state_3[#state_3 + 1] = instance_3
                                end
                            else
                                state_3[#state_3 + 1] = instance_3
                            end
                        else
                            state_3[#state_3 + 1] = instance_3
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        table.sort(state_3, helper)
        for index = #state_3, result + 1, -1 do
            state_3[index] = nil
        end
        return state_3
    end
    local function helper_3()
        if enabled then
            return
        elseif not (lifecycle.alive()) then
            return
        end
        enabled = true
        task.defer(function()
            enabled = false
            if lifecycle.alive() then
                pcall(lib_2.spectators, lib_2, helper_2())
            end
        end)
    end
    local function helper_4(argument)
        if argument == local_player then
            return
        elseif state_2[argument] then
            return
        end
        state_2[argument] = argument:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsSpectating"):Connect(helper_3)
    end
    for key_3, item in players_service:GetPlayers() do
        helper_4(item)
    end
    lifecycle.connect(local_player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Spectators"), helper_3)
    lifecycle.connect(players_service.PlayerAdded, function(argument_2)
        helper_4(argument_2)
        helper_3()
    end)
    lifecycle.connect(players_service.PlayerRemoving, function(argument_3)
        local connection = state_2[argument_3]
        if connection then
            connection:Disconnect()
            state_2[argument_3] = nil
        end
        helper_3()
    end)
    lifecycle.teardown(function()
        for key_4, connection_2 in state_2, nil, nil do
            connection_2:Disconnect()
            state_2[key_4] = nil
        end
    end)
    helper_3()
    return true
end

local lifecycle = module_registry.load("lifecycle")
lifecycle.takeover()
local reclaim = module_registry.load("roblox_services").reclaim
local interface_root, character_tracking =
    module_registry.load("interface_root"), module_registry.load("character_tracking")
local avatar_interface = module_registry.load("avatar_interface")
local viewmodel_materials = module_registry.load("viewmodel_materials")
local world_visuals = module_registry.load("world_visuals")
local scope_overlay = module_registry.load("scope_overlay")
local crosshair_overlay = module_registry.load("crosshair_overlay")
local weapon_presentation = module_registry.load("weapon_presentation")
local shot_effects = module_registry.load("shot_effects")
local drawing_renderer = module_registry.load("drawing_renderer")
module_registry.load("editable_overlay_canvas")
local grenade_prediction = module_registry.load("grenade_prediction")
local world_object_overlay = module_registry.load("world_object_overlay")
module_registry.load("movement_features")
local visual_removals = module_registry.load("visual_removals")
local miscellaneous_features = module_registry.load("miscellaneous_features")
local hit_markers = module_registry.load("hit_markers")
local combat_notifications, damage_screen_effect =
    module_registry.load("combat_notifications"), module_registry.load("damage_screen_effect")
local aim_hooks = module_registry.load("aim_hooks")
local aim_fov_overlay = module_registry.load("aim_fov_overlay")
local weapon_actions = module_registry.load("weapon_actions")
local trigger_controller = module_registry.load("trigger_controller")
local trigger_fov_overlay = module_registry.load("trigger_fov_overlay")
module_registry.load("skin_changer")
reclaim()
module_registry.load("visual_settings_interface")
module_registry.load("antiaim_settings_interface")
module_registry.load("misc_settings_interface")
module_registry.load("aim_settings_interface")
module_registry.load("trigger_settings_interface")
module_registry.load("spectator_list")
module_registry.load("music_interface")
local function run_feature(callback)
    pcall(callback)
    reclaim()
end
local function sync_features()
    run_feature(visual_removals.sync)
    run_feature(world_visuals.sync)
    run_feature(weapon_presentation.step)
    run_feature(miscellaneous_features.step)
    run_feature(aim_hooks.auto)
end
local function update_visuals()
    run_feature(character_tracking.step)
    run_feature(weapon_actions.step)
    run_feature(trigger_controller.step)
    run_feature(damage_screen_effect.step)
    run_feature(world_visuals.step_fx)
    run_feature(scope_overlay.step)
    run_feature(grenade_prediction.step)
    run_feature(crosshair_overlay.step)
    run_feature(shot_effects.step)
    run_feature(aim_fov_overlay.step)
    run_feature(trigger_fov_overlay.step)
end
local function update_effects()
    run_feature(viewmodel_materials.sync)
    run_feature(drawing_renderer.pump)
    run_feature(world_object_overlay.step)
    run_feature(hit_markers.step)
end
local update_callbacks, register_updates =
    { beat = sync_features, early = update_visuals, late = update_effects }, function(...)
        local callbacks = ...
        local run_service = game:GetService("RunService")
        local early_binding = "\0" .. tostring(math.random(1e7, 9e7))
        local late_binding = "\0" .. tostring(math.random(1e7, 9e7))
        callbacks.hb = run_service.Heartbeat:Connect(callbacks.beat)
        run_service:BindToRenderStep(early_binding, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 3, callbacks.early)
        run_service:BindToRenderStep(late_binding, Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value + 1, callbacks.late)
        callbacks.stop = function()
            run_service:UnbindFromRenderStep(early_binding)
            run_service:UnbindFromRenderStep(late_binding)
        end
    end
if register_updates and pcall(register_updates, update_callbacks) then
    lifecycle.adopt(update_callbacks.hb)
    if type(update_callbacks.stop) == "function" then
        lifecycle.teardown(update_callbacks.stop)
    end
else
    lifecycle.connect(module_registry.load("roblox_services").run.Heartbeat, sync_features)
    lifecycle.bind(Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 3, update_visuals)
    lifecycle.bind(Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value + 1, update_effects)
end
shot_effects.attach(combat_notifications.from_packet)
combat_notifications.start()
avatar_interface.Load()
lifecycle.teardown(function()
    if avatar_interface._loaded then
        pcall(avatar_interface.Unload)
    end
end)
interface_root.finish()
pcall(function()
    interface_root.win:log("спасибо шитаро!")
end)
pcall(function()
    game:GetService("StarterGui")
        :SetCore(
            "SendNotification",
            { Title = "shitaro", Text = "спасибо шитаро!", Duration = 5 }
        )
end)
lifecycle.publish(lifecycle.release)
return true
